Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to keep you safe 🚫.

JACK:
I don't care! I won't take it! (he stands up and blocks Dr. Smith's path) You can't make me! I won't be a slave to your pills 💔.

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine, Jack. If you won't take it, then I'll take it for you. (he holds out the pills) Here, take these and be done with it 🤯.

JACK:
(smirking) Oh, you want to play it that way? (he takes the pills and holds them up) I'll show you what's safe! (he opens his mouth and swallows the pills) Ha! You can't control me! (he grins maniacally) Now, watch me disappear! 🔮

Dr. Smith watches in amazement as Jack's body begins to fade away, like a ghost vanishing into thin air 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) What...what just happened? 🤯

As Dr. Smith looks around, he realizes that Jack is truly gone, and he's left standing alone in the empty room 🏠.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) Oh no...oh no, no, no... (he looks down at his hands and sees that they're shaking) Wait a minute... (he looks up and sees Jack standing in front of him, a mischievous grin on his face) Ah, Jack! You're back! 😈

JACK:
(laughing) You're the one who's been playing games, Doc! You're the one who's been pretending to be sane! (he chuckles maniacally) You're the one who's been living in a world of your own making! 🌐

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth: he's been the one with the schizophrenia all along 🤯.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
